8:17.text: You killed them not, but Allâh killed them. And you
threw not when you did throw, but Allâh threw, that He might test the believers by a fair trial from Him. Verily, Allâh is All-Hearer, All-Knower.

8:18.text: and surely, Allâh weakens the deceitful plots of the disbelievers.

8:19.text: if you ask for a judgement, now has the judgement come unto you; and if you cease
, it will be better for you, and if you return
, so shall We return, and your forces will be of no avail to you, however numerous they be; and verily, Allâh is with the believers.

8:20.text: O you who believe! Obey Allâh and His Messenger, and turn not away from him
(i.e. Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)

8:21.text: And be not like those who say: "We have heard," but they hear not.

8:22.text: living creatures with Allâh are the deaf and the dumb, who understand not

8:23.text: Had Allâh known of any good in them, He would indeed have made them listen; and even if He had made them listen, they would but have turned away with aversion

8:24.text: O you who believe! Answer Allâh
to that which will give you life,
and know that Allâh comes in between a person and his heart
(i.e. He prevents an evil person to decide anything)
. And verily to Him you shall

8:25.text: those of you who do wrong
(but it may afflict all the good and the bad people)
, and know that Allâh is Severe in punishment.
